summary: Tested inline-editable content feature on /legal-journal. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (auth, diary CRUD, stats, and new content GET/PUT). Frontend: all edit-persist flows work end-to-end (hero_lede, location_heading, metric_days_label) with PUT /api/content returning 200, values persisting across reload, and defaults restored. Public view is non-editable while admin sees contentEditable=true. Map iframe renders and is not editable but its caption is editable when logged in. Diary Add Entry button, tabs, and week filters still work.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid attribute was only rendered in the admin (contentEditable) branch — public visitors' editable elements had no data-testid, making them un-selectable by tests and violating the review requirement that 'elements with data-testid starting editable- should NOT have contenteditable=true' for logged-out users.

action_items: None blocking. Testing agent already added data-testid to the public (non-admin) branch of /app/frontend/src/components/legal-journal/Editable.jsx so public non-editable text now carries data-testid=editable-<key> as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: Editable.jsx used inline contentEditable rendering the value as a React child. This can cause the caret to jump / typing to be wiped on parent re-renders (framer-motion animations + optimistic setOverrides triggers re-render). During testing the current flows all persisted correctly, but there is latent risk. Consider using dangerouslySetInnerHTML on mount only, or an uncontrolled ref-based approach that only reads on blur.
ContentUpdate model has no length limit / sanitization on 'value' — could accept arbitrarily large strings.
Both admin and non-admin branches of Editable now share the same data-testid; keep this consistent going forward.
test_credentials: alex@journal.com / alex2026 (from review request; login worked as expected)
seed_data_creation: Created and removed a TEST_content_key in db.content via backend PUT test (harmless leftover, not surfaced in UI defaults).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editable component now attaches data-testid in both branches. Backend content endpoints: GET /api/content (public), PUT /api/content (Bearer token). All hero/location/metric text edits confirmed to persist through PUT and reload. Defaults left restored to original CONTENT_DEFAULTS.
rca of the issue: Editable.jsx early-returned for !isAdmin without data-testid, so playwright selectors [data-testid=editable-*] resolved to null in the logged-out state. Fixed by adding data-testid to the public branch.
